answer: The delta test I would run is Signed butterfly survey transect with conservation society attestation: a transect the conservation society walked weekly for three summers, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the lantern compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The mesa grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
